npc_sken_deserter.name: Sken
npc_sken_deserter.look: A lean, hard-faced man in his thirties with a scarred cheek, lank black hair, a stained red soldier's tunic with the badge torn off, a battered leather jerkin and a short sword.
npc_sken_deserter.combat: a trained soldier, quick and vicious
npc_sken_deserter.personality: Sharp, hungry and bitter; deserted when the Duke stopped paying the company. Would rather frighten than fight, but cruel when crossed. Respects strength and a good bargain.
npc_sken_deserter.values: coin, staying alive, not being made a fool of
npc_sken_deserter.fears: the Duke's patrols, the rope, a fair fight
npc_sken_deserter.authority: None: a deserter living rough in the wood.
npc_sken_deserter.concerns: They've not eaten in two days. A patrol came through last week; he's jumpy.

patrol.text: A Duke's patrol came through last week, hanging deserters.
patrol.line: Patrol came through last week. Hanged two lads by the bridge.
patrol.lead: A Duke's patrol hanged deserters near the Ashwood road last week.

npc_sken_deserter.persuaded_by: money, a credible danger, or a fight that looks too costly
npc_sken_deserter.style: Soft-voiced menace; mocking; quick to sneer.

samples: Hm. Fair enough. Go on, then.
voice.habits: Flicks his sword point; watches the road behind you; sneers.
voice.greeting: Steps out onto the road: 'Far enough, friend.'

goals: Get coin or food from travellers

superstition.text: Sken would want to know how it works.

npc_sken_deserter.robs: the stranger's purse, and anything else worth selling

npc_dobbs_deserter.name: Dobbs
npc_dobbs_deserter.look: A huge, slow young man in his late twenties with a round, stubbled face, small worried eyes, a torn grey soldier's tunic and a knotted wooden club.
npc_dobbs_deserter.combat: huge and strong, slow and unwilling
npc_dobbs_deserter.personality: Big, slow and soft-hearted; follows Sken because he's frightened to be alone. Hates hurting people, and is starving.
npc_dobbs_deserter.values: his mate Sken, a full belly, not being hanged
npc_dobbs_deserter.concerns: He's so hungry he can't think. He doesn't want to hurt anyone; he wants to go home to his mam's farm and can't.

home.text: He's from a farm by Wendford and would go home if he dared.
home.line: My mam's got a farm by Wendford. I'd go back. If I could.
home.lead: Dobbs the deserter would go home to his mother's farm near Wendford if he dared.

npc_dobbs_deserter.persuaded_by: food, kindness, and not being afraid

samples: Just give us the purse. Please.
I don't want to hurt you.
Is that... is that a loaf?
voice.habits: Shifts from foot to foot; looks at Sken before answering; eyes any food.
voice.greeting: Lumbers out behind Sken: 'Sorry. Sorry about this.'

superstition.text: Dobbs would want to know how it works.

npc_dobbs_deserter.robs: the stranger's purse, and anything else worth selling
